_audit._source: IDFC FIRST per-card 'Communication' PDFs (read via pypdf)
_audit.result: Ashva/Mayura corrected to per-Rs150 earn (see INDEX.md); other IDFC cards already per-Rs150

ashva.result: Reviewed current Ashva product and eligibility pages, launch release, current rewards/benefit terms, zero-forex notice, general MITC and shared insurance schedule. Corrected network tier and launch date, spend-tiered earn model, foreign ATM fee caveat, fees, lounge/golf/movie/milestone/insurance benefits, and age eligibility.
unresolved: The 17-Sep-2026 bank-wide zero-forex notice conflicts with the Ashva FAQ stating 1% markup for overseas ATM withdrawals; purchase markup is modeled at zero and the ATM-specific statement is retained in notes pending clearer terms.
Effective 26-Oct-2026 international earn is 2 points per INR150, but issuer copy does not resolve whether it still counts toward the INR20,000 monthly threshold.
Ashva app travel-booking bonus amounts conflict across the May-2026 cardmember communication, current product page and detailed terms; no app bonus rate is modeled.
Golf provides up to two monthly rounds or lessons as a shared pool; schema allows unknown/null separate round and lesson counts, so the split is not asserted.
IDFC FIRST general eligibility says Indian citizen; Ashva-specific income and numeric credit-score thresholds are not published, and the data schema has no citizenship field.

classic.result: Reviewed current FIRST Classic page, May-2026 and January-2026 card communications, linked privilege and Tripstacc terms, current MITC and the initial/revised zero-forex reward notices. Corrected the proposed international rewards stop after IDFC?s 13-Sep revision; refreshed rewards, fee and benefit evidence; removed unsupported travel insurance.
unresolved: Current product page still contains the withdrawn 26-Oct international reward stop footnote; the revised 13-Sep bank notice says international rewards continue at each card?s applicable rate.
Travel-booking bonus rates conflict: current page and May-2026 notice say 20% hotel/10% flight; January update and detailed terms say 33%/13%.
Current railway lounge page specifies a monthly INR20,000 access gate; linked privileges PDF confirms four quarterly visits but omits the gate.
Current card-linked privileges PDF names Paytm for movies and lists no travel insurance/personal air-accident cover for Classic, but has no clear publication date.
Fuel waiver transaction limits/cap are not re-confirmed by current card communication.
General eligibility source conflicts on age (21 vs 18) and states Indian citizenship rather than residence; no Classic-specific age or score floor is published.

diamond-reserve.result: Reviewed current Diamond Reserve product and eligibility pages, Jan-2026 launch release, June privileges, May communication, current MITC, Aug-2026 shared insurance schedule, international-rewards notices and zero-forex notice. Corrected fee effective date and eligibility notes, added credit-shield cover and documented unresolved CFAR and travel-reward conflicts.
unresolved: Revised bank-wide international-rewards notice conflicts with current Diamond-specific terms excluding international rewards; record follows card-specific terms.
App travel-booking bonus rates conflict across marketing page, May communication and detailed privileges terms; no bonus rate is modeled.
Current product page advertises INR25,000 CFAR, but the linked card policy ended 7-May-2026 and no replacement policy period was found.
Jan-2026 launch release lists INR10 lakh personal accident cover while the later Aug-2026 shared insurer schedule lists INR5 lakh; record uses the later schedule.
No Diamond-specific numeric income or credit-score threshold was found; general lounge-card guidance supports age 21 and stable income only.

first-private.result: Reviewed the current FIRST Private page and 17-Jul-2026 consolidated terms, current bank-wide insurance overview and fee policy. Verified post-July issue fees, current rewards, travel and lifestyle terms; corrected CFAR period and insurance record while documenting insurer-summary conflicts.
unresolved: Card-specific product page states INR50,000 zero card-liability cover while the current general insurance overview table lists INR5 lakh for FIRST Private; the card-specific figure is retained pending clarification.
The standalone one-page CFAR PDF linked by the issuer is stale (ends 7-May-2025); the July-2026 consolidated card terms and live product page support a policy through 7-May-2027.
The current insurance overview lists INR25 lakh personal accident cover, but the card-specific consolidated terms describe the coverage without restating its sum insured.
Fees and reward changes effective 17-Jul-2026 distinguish new issuance cohorts; the live page does not fully explain treatment of accounts issued earlier.
Card-specific age, income and credit-score thresholds remain unpublished.

gaj.result: Reviewed the current Gaj page, launch release, linked privileges/reward terms, May-2026 reward update and current MITC. Corrected shared golf-pool representation, insurance classification/coverage, annual fee payment reward and unsupported residency; added credit-shield cover and DCC/transaction-limit caveats.
unresolved: The detailed Gaj privileges terms limit golf to 24 shared rounds or lessons per year, while product page headlines use broad unlimited wording; structured round/lesson counts remain null.
The 15,000-point app travel cap applies to bonus points, and schema cannot express that distinction cleanly from total earn.
The card page says zero forex; merchant DCC may still impose up to 5% as described in the linked privileges PDF.
The exact CFAR policy period, card-specific APR, age, numeric income/credit-score threshold and residency requirement are not published in current Gaj public sources.
Issuer page mentions movie ticket and 300+ merchant offers without publishing Gaj-specific movie terms.

hello-cashback.result: Reviewed the current Hello Cashback page, product feature terms and guide, current customer MITC and bank-wide zero-forex notice. Corrected unsupported RuPay Select tier and single-held FD wording, added source detail for cashback/insurance/fees, and recorded the joining-offer date conflict.
unresolved: No official launch date or card-network tier was identified; network is RuPay, tier is null.

The issuer FAQ on the current page conflicts internally: one joining-offer section says 30-Oct-2026 and another says 31-Oct-2026; record follows the latter, but confirm with issuer before relying on the offer after 30-Oct.

The live page says additional fixed deposits from INR5,000 may be linked to raise the card limit; exact FD lien, renewal-mode and account-ownership requirements are not fully specified in the linked Hello Cashback feature document.
Issuer page does not publish a card-specific post-onboarding APR; revolving APR remains null.
Current card cashback feature terms do not state an original effective date for the tier/cap structure; effective_from is the date verified, not a launch date.

indigo.result: Reviewed the live IndiGo Dual card page and Oct-2026 offer terms, 18-Aug-2025 launch release, May-2026 communication, current product guide and privileges, current MITC and bank-wide zero-forex notice. Corrected insurance classifications and golf quantity based on the detailed issuer FAQ; added current one-time partner offers and documented source conflicts.
unresolved: The FD-backed joining-fee route is described with a minimum INR50,000 FD in the headline/FAQ and INR1 lakh in the eligibility/application workflow.
The live product page's dedicated headline/FAQ says zero forex, while one stale paragraph still says 1.49%; the record follows the zero-forex policy effective 17-Sep-2026.

The detailed FAQ states 12 golf rounds plus 12 lessons per year, while the same current page's Mastercard World graphic and linked Product Guide say four rounds plus 12 lessons; the record follows the detailed FAQ.
Trip-cancellation terms state coverage through 7-May-2027 in one section but list the policy period ending 7-May-2026 in another; active claim period should be confirmed with issuer/insurer.
The reward model cannot fully encode RuPay UPI rail overrides or all MCC-level low-earn categories; BluChip cash value varies by flight and booking conditions.

lic-select.result: Reviewed the current LIC Select page, 18-Jun-2026 Travel & Shop terms, March welcome offer, current lounge list, linked privileges/Product Usage Guide, MITC and bank-wide zero-forex notice. Encoded the INR20,000 prior-month airport lounge gate; corrected the network to Mastercard and cleared unsupported Visa Signature; corrected baggage-delay type and documented current conflicts.
unresolved: Welcome reward amount conflicts: product page says 2,000 points while linked offer PDF says 2,500; threshold also conflicts (INR10,000 vs more than INR10,000).
Travel bonus percentages in the detailed June 2026 T&C are 20% hotel/8% flight, while current product page shows 45 points/INR125, 20 points/INR125 and an up-to-40% headline.
No card-specific Mastercard tier, exact launch date, age, income, score or residency cutoff was found in the current official source set.
Current product page summarizes insurance amounts, while linked privileges-policy text extraction has ambiguous table alignment; verify the applicable insurer schedule for claims.

mayura.result: Reviewed current product page, May-2026 card communication, reward structure, launch release and zero-forex notice. Corrected network, launch date, duplicated benefits and baggage-delay classification; cleared unsupported residency-only and Visa Infinite claims.
unresolved: Current product page/current FAQ advertise 30X hotel/15X flight bonus points, while May-2026 communication states 20% hotel and 10% flight bonuses on applicable base points.
Current product page says trip-cancellation cover up to INR50,000 twice per year; 2024 launch release says in a calendar year. Precise policy terms unresolved.
Card-specific income, age, bureau-score and residency criteria are not published on the current card page.

millennia.result: Reviewed the current Millennia page, May-2026 communication, current privileges, product guide, MITC, zero-forex notice and issuer eligibility pages. Confirmed current reward periods and corrected stale international reward treatment; age conflict is documented and left unknown.
unresolved: Issuer Millennia eligibility sources conflict on minimum age (18 vs 21).
Card comparison says Indian residents; general issuer guidance also allows NRIs subject to card criteria.
Exact current card network tier is not stated; Visa is supported by issuer product-guide card artwork.

power-plus.result: Reviewed the current HPCL Power/Power+ page, May-2026 update, privileges, reward schedule, travel terms, welcome offer terms, current MITC and zero-forex notice. Current record matches the main fee and reward values; conflicts for the fuel surcharge waiver and welcome window remain documented.
unresolved: Card page says Power+ has no fuel surcharge waiver while general MITC lists 1% for Power and Power+ with cap Not Applicable.
Dedicated welcome offer terms give 60 days; product page FAQ also states 30 days.
Latest travel update expresses bonus as percentages while older travel terms list absolute points per INR150; percentage basis and 8,000 monthly cap retained in notes.
No exact launch date or RuPay tier is published in the reviewed sources.

power.result: Reviewed the current Power/Power+ card page, May-2026 Power communication, current privileges, reward schedule, travel terms, welcome terms, MITC and zero-forex notice. Added advertised merchant offers without assigning cash value; retained fuel waiver and welcome-window conflicts.
unresolved: Card page says Power has no fuel surcharge waiver while general MITC lists a 1% waiver for Power/Power+ with cap Not Applicable.
Detailed welcome terms give 60 days for post-10-Jun-2025 setups; a product FAQ also says 30 days.
Travel bonus is stated in percentages in the latest update and absolute points in older terms; the schema cannot represent the percentage basis.
Self-employed age minimum 25 conflicts with combined age 21+ criterion; no exact launch date or network tier was found.

secured-rupay.result: Reviewed the current FIRST EARN issuer product page, launch announcement, current general MITC/fees, zero-forex announcement and latest card-specific E-Kit and privileges. Corrected launch, fee timeline, zero forex, cashback/reward terms, eligibility and current movie, roadside and insurance benefits.
unresolved: Current MITC cash-advance transaction fee is a flat INR199; card schema supports only percentage and minimum, so exact value is recorded in source notes and the unsupported percentage object is null.
Current issuer page no longer confirms the older fuel-surcharge-waiver boundaries/cap, so no waiver is asserted; it separately confirms fuel purchases earn cashback.
Current product page advertises up to 5% bonus cashback on travel bookings, but linked program-specific terms and scope need a separate current-source review.

select.result: Reviewed the current FIRST Select product page, linked 2026 product usage guide, and January 2026 reward / April 2026 lounge update PDF. Corrected current fees, reward base and category rates, lounge quotas, current welcome/movie/fuel benefits and income threshold; documented conflicting points expiry, lounge qualification, and travel-booking bonus copy.
unresolved: Product page and guide conflict on whether the INR20,000 airport/rail lounge spend gate applies in the current month or previous month; use monthly threshold with activation next month pending clearer operational terms.
Product page's travel booking bonus states 20% hotel / 10% flight, while current Select update PDF states 33% / 13%; structured benefit notes preserve both pending reconciliation.
Issuer pages conflict on Reward Point expiry: one redemption FAQ says points never expire, while current terms say 24 months. Record follows explicit 24-month terms.
Cash advance fee is flat INR199 + GST per transaction; schema cannot represent a flat fee, so fee object is null and exact fee is in notes.

swyp.result: Reviewed current FIRST SWYP product page, 2023-12-08 launch announcement, May-2026 card communication with June/July updates, card privileges terms, current general MITC, and current travel bonus terms. Corrected network/launch, zero forex, fee model, milestone rewards, welcome/annual offers, fuel/movie/railway/insurance benefits and EMI/cash-advance details.
unresolved: Current SWYP product page does not publish card-specific eligibility age, income or credit-score thresholds.
Joining fee waiver is through the first successful referral; the fee schema models only spend-based waiver criteria, so the condition is in benefit notes.
Flat INR199 cash advance fee is not representable in the percentage/minimum fee schema; exact amount is retained in the fee notes.
Merchant EMI fees and rates vary by transaction/merchant/tenure; current issuer page does not publish a single numeric rate.
The 2023 launch release identifies Mastercard, but the current product page does not publish a Mastercard tier; tier is left unknown.

wealth.result: Reviewed the current Wealth card page, January/May 2026 card communications, reward/travel T&Cs, current privileges and general MITC. Corrected reward base/effective categories and international earn end-date, fee/forex/cash terms, Visa Infinite tier, lounge/movie/fuel/golf/railway benefits, insurance and eligibility.
unresolved: Current Wealth product copy conflicts on international earning: an explicit effective-26-Oct-2026 footnote says international transactions earn no points, while banners/FAQ and the current reward T&C still show 10X international; YAML follows the dated footnote.
Railway lounge quota conflicts between the current product FAQ (4 per year) and detailed privileges PDF (up to 4 per quarter); YAML records the conflict without selecting a quota.

Travel booking terms say 20% hotel / 10% flight bonus, but product-page FAQ examples, rate tables and percentages do not reconcile consistently; bonuses and the 8,000 monthly bonus cap are noted but not encoded as rates.
Exact card launch day is not verified; an issuer investor filing identifies launch in January 2021, so launched_on is null.
Issuer page lists annual income INR36 lakh or more but does not distinguish salaried/self-employed thresholds; issuer blog also describes a Wealth banking relationship as an alternate path.
The current document set includes both a general Wealth travel-insurance summary and itemized coverage; exact policy eligibility/claim limits remain subject to the attached privileges terms.

wow-black.result: Reviewed current WOW! Black product page, 8-Dec-2025 launch release, current privileges document and current customer MITC. Corrected launch/network, fees, reward earn and redemption, lounge quota/spend gate, welcome package, fuel waiver, movie offer, insurance/CFAR/roadside benefits and secured eligibility.
unresolved: Issuer describes flight/hotel app bonuses with percentage headlines but specific examples state bonus points per INR100; modeled total points use the examples and remain medium confidence.
The product page's lounge FAQ uses both current-month and previous-month spend wording; it otherwise says current month unlocks next month.
Cash advance fee is flat INR199 plus taxes per transaction, not representable in the current percentage/minimum schema; exact amount retained in fee notes.
The card page advertises welcome offers as worth over INR5,000, but several are partner discounts/memberships rather than cash equivalents.

wow.result: Reviewed current FIRST WOW! product page and customer MITC, May-2026 card communication, and earlier update to identify superseded reward and benefit claims. Corrected reward base/rates, expiry, cash fee, standard-card benefits, fuel waiver, network platform and secured eligibility.
unresolved: Current fixed monthly finance charge is not stated; issuer publishes a variable APR range.

Older Dec-2025 update listed INR200,000 personal accident and INR25,000 lost-card cover; latest May-2026 update and current page do not reaffirm these, so they are excluded pending current confirmation.
Fuel-waiver transaction bounds are not stated in current product communication.
